main_text.p: נבח Latravit: Infin. לֹא יוּכְלוּ לִנְבֹּחַ Non possint La-trare, Jesa.56.10.
נבט Intuitus est: Praeter. וְנִבַּט Et intuebitur Jes.5. verf.30. quod alii ex Pihel, alii ex Niphal est. Hiph. הִבִּיט Idem: Praeter. מִשָּׁמַיִם הִבִּיט E' cœlis intue-tur, Psal.33.13.

מַבָּט m. Exspectatio, quasi Aspectum vel Respectum dicas, Aff. מַבָּטָם Exspectatione suâ, Jesa.20.5. מַבָּטֵנוּ Exspectatio nostra, Ibid.6. Et cum Sægol ab initio, מַבָּטָהּ Exspectatio sua, Zach.9.5.

נבל Cecidit, Concidit, Decidit, & de emarcidis ac flaccidis proprie dicitur: unde & Emarcescere, Flaccescere. Item, Stultescere, Stultè agere. Praeter. נָבְלָה צִיץ Decidit flos, Jes.40.8. אִם־נָבַלְתָּ Si cecidisti, Prov. 39.32. juxta R.Levi: At Aben Esra, Si stultè egisti, deducta significatione ex Nomine נָבָל. Pih. נִבֵּל Vilipendit, Turpitudine affecit: Praeter. וְנִבַּלְתִּיךָ Et turpitudine afficiam te, Nah.3.6. Particip. מְנַבֵּל Turpitudine afficit, Mich.7.6. Futur. וַיְנַבֵּל Et vilipendit, Deuter.32.15. תְּנַבֵּל Vilipendito, Jer.14.21. Hiph. Futur. irregulare, וַנַּבֵּל Et decidimus vel diffluimus, Jesa.64.6. pro וַיַּבֵּל, cui simile vide infrà in נוד.
נָבָל m. Stultus, Flagitiosus, Cui ratio & mens Concidit, ut stultè vel turpiter agat: Plur. הַנְּבָלִים Stulti, 2.Sam.13. v.13. Fœm. אַחַת הַנְּבָלוֹת Una stultarum, Job.2.10.
נְבָלָה f. Stultitia, Flagitium, Fœditas, Gen.34.7.
נְבָלוּת f. Idem: נִבְלוּתָהּ [?] Fœditatem vel stultitiam ejus, Hos.2.10.

נְבֵלָה f. Cadaver, quasi Caducum aut Deciduum dicas, & dicitur tam de hominis quàm bestiæ cadavere, Lev.22.8. Constr. נִבְלַת, 1.Reg.13. v.29. Aff. נִבְלָתוֹ Cadaver ejus, Deut.21.23. נִבְלָתִי Cadaver meum, Jesa.26.19.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew forms in the Nun-Bet entries are hard to read at this resolution; marked [?] where doubtful. The entry נְבָלוּת line (Hos.2.10) is the least certain. The "44ı" page number is read as 441. The Hebrew running head is read as נב.
